empty.title: No inventory items
empty.message: Add your first inventory item to start tracking stock at this location.

form.notesPlaceholder: Optional notes about this inventory item...
form.productInfo: The product this inventory item represents. Cannot be changed after creation.
form.skuInfo: Stock Keeping Unit — a unique identifier for this item at this location.
form.onHandInfo: Total quantity physically present at this location, including reserved units.
form.reservedInfo: Quantity set aside for pending orders. Deducted from available stock.
form.reorderLevelInfo: When on-hand stock drops to or below this level, a restock alert is triggered.
form.unitOfMeasureInfo: The unit used to count this item (e.g. pcs, kg, box).
form.notesInfo: Internal notes visible only to staff. Not shown to customers.
form.activeInfo: Inactive items are hidden from stock reports and cannot be sold.

serial.title: Serial Numbers
serial.serialNumberInfo: Unique identifier printed on the physical unit.
serial.imeiInfo: 15-digit IMEI for mobile or wireless devices. Leave blank if not applicable.
serial.statusInfo: Current lifecycle state of this unit (available, sold, reserved, defective, returned).
serial.warrantyStartInfo: Date the manufacturer warranty begins for this unit.
serial.warrantyEndInfo: Date the manufacturer warranty expires for this unit.
serial.purchaseOrderInfo: The purchase order this unit was received against.
serial.soldReferenceInfo: The sale or invoice reference when this unit was sold.

transaction.title: Transactions
transaction.typeInfo: The kind of stock movement being recorded.
transaction.quantityInfo: Number of units affected. Use a positive value.
transaction.dateInfo: Date when the movement actually occurred.
transaction.referenceInfo: Optional reference number (e.g. PO number, sale ID) for traceability.

depreciation.title: Depreciation
depreciation.methodInfo: Accounting method used to spread the asset's cost over its useful life.
depreciation.costBasisInfo: Original purchase cost of the asset in centavos (÷100 for display).
depreciation.salvageValueInfo: Estimated residual value at end of useful life, in centavos.
depreciation.usefulLifeInfo: Expected lifespan of the asset in months.
depreciation.startDateInfo: Date depreciation calculation begins (typically the acquisition date).

movements.title: Transactions
movements.subtitle: All transactions across products and locations
